svg.text: rx_lim: limiter stage + comparator with hysteresis (one per arm)
stage L 4/0.5 ×2 um, 25 uA, 10 kOhm (about 9 dB); comparator pair 2/0.5 ×2, diode loads 1/0.5, cross-coupled 1.7/0.5 (k = 1.7: hysteresis about +-35 mV)
both inputs AC-coupled (offsets only shift the thresholds); q full swing to uo[4] / uo[5]; source: sim/rx/rx_lim.py block()
